body:
Overall I think this is an amazing PR and I really appreciate it. Thank you so much for working on this!

The diff gets a little messy in some places because the actual implementation changes are mixed with some code-style and whitespace changes that I personally would prefer to leave out of the PR.

I made a few comments on some things that stood out to me, but overall I would like to get this merged for 4.8. I have tested the MRP and it does seem to improve things, and the approach looks sound in general.
